mainEntity.name: How long does an outdoor living space project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on scope and weather, and we won't pretend otherwise. A straightforward patio and seating area moves faster than a full outdoor kitchen with a fireplace and integrated lighting. What we will do is give you a specific timeline in writing during your free consultation, before you commit to anything, and tell you right away if weather is going to shift it.

mainEntity.name: What does an outdoor living space cost in Traverse City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every relationship and every project is unique, so we don't publish a price range that would be wrong for most people who read it. Cost depends on square footage, material selection, site conditions, grade, drainage needs, and features like fireplaces, kitchens, or lighting. After we see your space, you get a detailed written quote with no obligation, and that price is locked for 30 days.

mainEntity.name: How long will your crew be on my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: We give you the on-site window in your written estimate, and we hold to it unless weather forces a change. When that happens you hear it from us the same day. We keep the work area clean and safe the entire time, because you still have to live there while we're working.

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my yard before you start?

acceptedAnswer.text: We send a simple prep list a few days before the crew arrives. It typically covers moving patio furniture and planters, marking sprinkler heads and invisible fence lines, and clearing vehicle access to the work area. Nothing on it is difficult, and we'll walk through it with you if anything is unclear.

mainEntity.name: What are the phases of the project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Site visit and design, then written quote with your 30-day price lock, then scheduling and your prep list, then excavation and base preparation, then the paver or stone installation, then final detailing and cleanup. You'll know which phase we're in at every point. No surprises is not a slogan for us, it's how we run the schedule.
